source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names read from the page images; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1905: polled 25 May 1905 in five divisions (counted 26 May by T. W. Kilpatrick, returning officer). Markethill is not filed: both Armagh Guardian nomination lists print "Markethill—Wm. Simpson, J.P.", the Hamiltonsbawn member, apparently in error. Returned unopposed. R. G. M'Crum: no party label printed in 1905. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Crossmore, 28 May 1902, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 2 May 1902, p. 2 ("But Few Contests": county council nominations, with labels); members confirmed by the Lurgan Times, 7 June 1902, p. 3 ("Armagh County Council": complete list of the elected members); Crossmore, 27 May 1908, printed 'U.': Northern Whig, 6 June 1908, p. 10 ("Provincial Elections: County Councils: Armagh"); candidates in the Newry Reporter, 2 May 1908, p. 10 ("Armagh County Council": the nominations)).
